start.text: Willow's broomstick just ZOOMED into the bayou like it had somewhere better to be, and her witch exam is at sunrise — she can see sparks fading in the fog and weird glowing mushroom caps bobbing on the water. Spark trail or mushroom caps?

a.text: The sparks lead deeper in and every tree hollow is GLOWING from inside like the swamp has nightlights — Willow grabs the spell-lantern from the stump because a witch in a dark bayou needs all the light she can get. Foggy channel or vine bridge?

scare.reveal: Ribbit! We were just watching the sparks go by!

t.ja: ゲロゲロ！ ひばな が とんでいく の を みてた だけ！
t.cmn: 呱！ 我们只是在看火花飞过呢！
t.yue: 呱！ 我哋只係睇緊啲火花飛過啫！

b.text: Each mushroom cap BOUNCES like a trampoline and Willow nearly lost her hat twice — she grabs the humming singing reed from the mud and tucks it in her hat band because anything that sings might be useful later. Fog island or cypress cathedral?

aa.text: The fog is so thick Willow can only hear the broomstick buzzing, and something VERY large just rippled the water near that root — moonlit clearing or root tunnel?

ab.text: The vine bridge wobbled so hard Willow's hat nearly flew off, but the broomstick glow is CLOSE and flickering like it cannot decide where to hide — clearing or tunnel?

ba.text: The fog island is WEIRD — Willow looked into the water and her reflection was GRINNING when she was definitely not grinning, which is extremely rude of a reflection. Mushroom circle or waterfall?

bb.text: The cathedral is ENORMOUS and the broomstick is up there doing loop-de-loops near the ceiling like it is having the time of its life without Willow — the absolute nerve! Mushroom circle or waterfall?

m1.text: There it is — but the broomstick has a WILD SHADOW of its own that keeps scaring it in circles, and Willow needs to step behind a shape to cast a calmer shadow. Cat rock or snake root?

m2.text: The broomstick is backed into a corner and its wild shadow is FREAKING OUT — Willow needs a shadow shape that says I come in peace, not I come to crash into another tree. Frog stone or cat bark?

m3.text: The broomstick is doing LAPS around the mushroom circle and Willow has one shot at the perfect shadow shape — cat branch, snake vine, or frog toadstool?

m4.text: The broomstick is SHAKING and its wild shadow looks exhausted — this is not a fight, it is a scared broomstick that needs to know Willow will fly gently. Snake driftwood or frog boulder?

end_cat_grace.text: Willow's cat shadow stretched long and SLOW and the broomstick's wild shadow copied it perfectly — stretch, arch, purr-wiggle. The broomstick drifted down like a leaf and nuzzled her hand because the cat shadow proved she would never yank the handle or take a corner too fast again. The broomstick was never a phantom — it was a broom that wanted a rider who understood GRACE. Witch exam: passed with flying colors. The End!

end_snake_flee.text: The snake shadow HISSED and the broomstick decided nope nope NOPE — it rocketed into the fog so fast it left a violet comet trail, and by the time Willow stopped coughing on the sparks the sun was coming up. Turns out a scared broomstick does NOT like snakes. Witch exam: postponed! Oopsie ending!

end_frog_bounce.text: The frog shadow went boing-boing-boing and the broomstick's shadow went boing-boing-boing right back — before Willow knew it the broomstick was BOUNCING beside her like a happy puppy! It bonked her hat with its bristles and she laughed so hard the whole grotto glowed. The broomstick just wanted a rider who could be SILLY. The End!

end_gentle_land.text: The cat shadow curled up and tucked its paws, and the broomstick's wild shadow did EXACTLY the same thing — the broomstick floated down into Willow's lap like it had been waiting for permission to rest. The runaway was not being naughty — it was terrified of a crash-prone rider, and the gentle cat shadow proved those days were over. The End!

end_cat_dance.text: The cat shadow POUNCED between the toadstools and the broomstick chased it like a game of tag — around and around the mushroom circle until the broomstick swooped into Willow's arms, sparking with joy. The wild spirit was never a curse. It was a broomstick that wanted a rider who could PLAY. The End!

end_snake_spiral.text: The snake shadow spiraled and the broomstick spiraled and they BOTH spiraled so hard the broomstick drilled itself straight into the ground like a sparkly corkscrew! Willow tugged and tugged but the bristles were wedged in solid and the singing reed played the saddest trombone sound. Flying home is going to be a LONG walk. Oopsie ending!

end_frog_splash.text: The frog shadow leaped SO enthusiastically that the broomstick copied it right into the WATER — Willow went in after it and now they are both soaking, the bristles are full of duckweed, and the singing reed is making gargle noises. The mushroom circle is just watching like this is the funniest thing since tadpoles. Oopsie ending!

end_waterfall_calm.text: The snake shadow swayed like a lullaby and the broomstick's wild shadow swayed right along until the shaking stopped — the broomstick leaned against Willow's shoulder with a tired little hum. The singing reed joined in and the waterfall sang harmony, and by the time they flew home the broomstick trusted her completely. Gentlest flight of the whole semester. The End!

end_dawn_race.text: The frog shadow bounced and the broomstick bounced and then it bounced RIGHT THROUGH THE WATERFALL and wedged itself between two rocks like a very sparkly cork — by the time Willow pried it loose the sun was up and the exam was over. The broomstick looked extremely sorry but sorry does not un-miss a sunrise deadline. Oopsie ending!

start.text: Stars are going out like candles — something up there is gobbling them! The old observatory might have answers, or at least a telescope big enough to see what's hungry.

a.text: The biggest telescope EVER! It's pointed right where stars keep disappearing, and something is rumbling in the walls — is that snoring or the wind?

b.text: Someone has been crossing out stars on the maps — the SAME ones vanishing from the real sky! A trail of fresh quill ink leads deeper inside.

aa.text: AHHH! Something in the sky just BLINKED — a massive eye stared right back through the telescope! Whatever is out there, it knows Mo is watching.

ab.text: The Star Jar! It hums and glows like a tiny trapped galaxy. Now Mo just needs to get past whatever is snoring in the walls — and figure out what's eating the stars.

ba.text: The star chart is MOVING — the constellations rearranged into a face and it's mouthing something! The brass astrolabe starts spinning on its own too.

scare.reveal: Hello! I'm trying to show you a MAP! The star-sprite settles into a gentle glow and points at the sky with a tiny arm of light.

t.ja: こんにちは！ ちず を みせよう と してる の！ ほし の ようせい が やさしく ひかりだして、ちいさな ひかり の うで で そら を さしてる よ。
t.cmn: 你好！ 我想给你看一张地图！ 星星小精灵发出柔和的光，用小小的光臂指向天空。
t.yue: 你好呀！ 我想俾張地圖你睇呀！ 星星小精靈發出柔和嘅光，用佢隻小光臂指住個天呀。

bb.text: The porcupine astronomer fell asleep DECADES ago and he STILL rearranges furniture! His quills scratch the floor as he sleep-shuffles past, shoving bookshelves around in a dream.

choices.label: Grab a quill from the pot

m1.text: Paper-ball skirmish! The sleep-walking porcupine shuffles straight at Mo! Stuff a paper ball in the eyepiece to block his view, or crank the dome open to distract him with sky?

m2.text: The porcupine is sleep-counting stars and heading RIGHT THIS WAY! Roll his chair across the room or yank the dome lever?

m3.text: Triple-target paper-ball showdown — the porcupine is shuffling FAST! Block the eyepiece, crank the dome, or roll his chair?

m4.text: The star-moth watches calmly and the Star Jar hums — maybe these creatures aren't eating stars at all! Follow the moth outside or grab the jar to catch them?

end_blocked_view.text: The porcupine wanders off grumbling about clouds and Mo sneaks outside to see the truth — the star-moths are REPLANTING stars! They're building a brand-new constellation shaped like Mo's village, right down to the little fountain. The porcupine wakes, sees it, and weeps.

end_open_sky.text: The dome opens and sky pours in! Star-moths swirl like golden confetti, planting stars into a picture of Mo's village. The porcupine wakes, adjusts his spectacles, and happy-cries so hard his quills rattle.

end_chair_glide.text: Wheee goes the porcupine! While he rolls, Mo watches the truth unfold — the moths carry star-seeds to dark spots and PLANT them into a new constellation shaped like Mo's own village. The porcupine wakes, sees the sky, and sobs with joy.

end_lever_snap.text: CLANG! The lever snaps and the dome goes haywire — papers everywhere, the porcupine screaming about meteors, and Mo buried in star charts! The stars will have to wait for another night. Oopsie ending!

end_eyepiece_bullseye.text: Bullseye! While the porcupine fiddles with the blocked eyepiece, Mo sees the truth — the star-moths are planting a constellation of Mo's village! The porcupine gasps, pulls out a fresh chart, and draws it through tears of wonder.

end_dome_flood.text: Mo's paper ball jammed the dome crank halfway open and rain poured in like somebody turned on a giant shower — the porcupine woke up SCREAMING about his telescope getting wet and Mo spent the next hour mopping the floor with soggy star charts while the moths did their beautiful work outside where nobody could see it! Oopsie ending!

end_spin_tumble.text: Mo's paper ball sent the chair rolling and it crashed into the TELESCOPE — the biggest, most irreplaceable telescope in the observatory went CLANG and tipped sideways while the porcupine got tangled in the tripod like the world's prickliest pretzel! The old astronomer woke up furious and Mo spent the rest of the night helping realign a telescope he was definitely not qualified to touch. Oopsie ending!

end_moth_garden.text: Mo follows the moth and sees everything — they're not eating stars, they're PLANTING a new constellation shaped like Mo's village! Every street, every rooftop, drawn in starlight. The porcupine wakes at last and whispers: that is the most beautiful thing in all my years of watching the sky.

end_jar_fright.text: The Star Jar scares all the moths away and the beautiful constellation falls apart into random sparkles! The porcupine is FURIOUS and Mo gets bonked with a chart. Those moths were making something beautiful and now it's gone. Oopsie ending!

start.text: The museum is closed but the moonlight is open for business! The Midnight Sapphire is gone from its pedestal and somebody needs to figure out who took it — let's investigate!

a.text: Giant bones everywhere and something scratches behind the diorama glass! A shimmering magpie feather on the floor — that's a clue worth following.

b.text: The sapphire is GONE and glitter trails sparkle both ways across the floor! The owl night-guard could swoop in any second so Milo had better pick a trail fast.

aa.text: The diorama wolf just turned its head — and now the WHOLE PACK is staring at Milo! One by one they shifted when he wasn't looking.

ab.text: The logbook says the sapphire vanished YEARS ago — and someone drew a little magpie in the margins with fresh ink! Whoever took it has been coming back.

ba.text: Whooo goes there — the owl docent swoops overhead with spectacles glinting! Better find cover before those sharp eyes spot Milo.

bb.text: The dinosaur skeleton just SHIFTED — its jaw clicked open wider and something alive scurries inside those giant ribs!

scare.reveal: Just a grumpy museum gecko who naps in the skeleton! She's been living there for years and does NOT appreciate visitors.

t.ja: ほね の なか で おひるね する きげん の わるい はくぶつかん の ヤモリ！ なんねん も そこ に すんでて、おきゃくさん は だいきらい な の！
t.cmn: 只是只脾气不好的博物馆壁虎，它在骨头里睡觉呢！ 它在那里住了好多年，不喜欢有访客！
t.yue: 只係隻脾氣唔好嘅博物館壁虎，佢喺骨頭入面瞓緊覺咋！ 佢喺度住咗好多年喇，唔鍾意有訪客㗎！

m1.text: Flashlight tag! The owl is DIVING straight at Milo — grab the flashlight and shine it through a gem to dazzle her!

m2.text: The owl's spectacles gleam in the dark! Blast the flashlight through the quartz for a rainbow scatter-shot, or hide behind that enormous mammoth tusk?

m3.text: Triple gem showdown — the owl hoots and CHARGES! Red ruby dazzle, green emerald camouflage, or white quartz rainbow scatter-shot?

m4.text: The magpie is TREMBLING — she's carrying the sapphire TOWARD the pedestal, not away! She's been trying to return it and just needed someone brave to help.

end_ruby_dazzle.text: Ruby-red light everywhere! The owl is so dazzled she topples onto a bench. The magpie finally returns the sapphire she stole years ago — Milo held her wing the whole way to the pedestal.

end_emerald_forest.text: Milo fumbled the emerald and it rolled across the marble floor like a glowing green bowling ball — the flashlight sent spinning lasers everywhere, the owl chased the rolling light like a cat with a laser pointer, and Milo slid across the polished floor on his belly trying to catch it! The magpie watched from a rafter holding the sapphire and shaking her head. Oopsie ending!

end_quartz_disco.text: Rainbow disco party! The owl waltzes with a statue and the magpie finally returns the sapphire she has been too ashamed to face for years. Tonight Milo gave her the courage to set it right.

end_bouncy_chaos.text: Bouncy balls EVERYWHERE! The owl slips, the magpie flaps in circles, and Milo lands face-first in gift-shop plushies. The sapphire stays lost tonight. Oopsie ending!

end_ruby_sunset.text: The owl is a BURRITO now! The magpie has been trying to return the sapphire for years — she just needed someone kind to stand beside her at the pedestal.

end_emerald_meadow.text: The green light made the owl SNEEZE so hard the emerald flew off its chain and Milo tripped over the velvet rope trying to catch it — he landed in a pile of brochures and the owl circled back looking MORE awake than ever! The magpie sighed from her windowsill and tucked the sapphire back under her wing for another night. Oopsie ending!

end_rainbow_cathedral.text: Rainbow scatter-shot lights the whole museum like stained glass! The magpie came back every night for years, too ashamed to face the empty pedestal alone. Tonight she finally had Milo.

end_sapphire_together.text: Milo and the magpie return the sapphire together. The owl bows — she was never trying to catch a thief, she was waiting for the magpie to forgive herself.

end_fountain_splash.text: The sapphire sinks to the bottom of the fountain with a sad little blurp! The magpie cries, the owl is furious, and Milo is very, very wet. Oopsie ending!

start.text: A star just fell RIGHT into the lagoon and dissolved into a million colors, but it left behind this tiny seed pulsing in Pearl's paws — the old sea turtle said to plant it in the deep spring before it fades or the lagoon loses its glow FOREVER. Coral arch or vine curtain?

a.text: Under the arch Pearl finds a little pearl wedged in the coral that SINGS when she touches it — a single clear note that makes the star-seed pulse brighter, so into the satchel it goes alongside the star-seed. Kelp garden or anemone cluster?

b.text: The silk vines tingle like tiny electric eels and on the other side Pearl spots a moonstone shell that HUMS when she picks it up — it vibrates near the star-seed like they are old friends, which is adorable and also slightly weird. Tide pools or urchin ridge?

aa.text: The kelp garden is like a glowing green forest and the singing pearl hums a note that parts the fronds — the star-seed is flickering faster now, fading a little, and Pearl can see two ways deeper into the lagoon. Sapphire waterfall or starfish ledge?

ab.text: The anemones are SO soft and they curl around Pearl's paws like little hugs — the singing pearl chimes a note that makes the anemones release her gently, and she can see two paths from up here while the star-seed flickers faster. Sapphire cascade or starfish shelf?

ba.text: The tide pools are warm as bathwater and the little hermit crabs wave their claws in greeting — then Pearl spots it: a FORTRESS made entirely of shells blocking the way to the deep spring, and she can hear bubbling behind it. Shell fortress or spring tunnel?

bb.text: The urchins are surprisingly friendly and roll aside to let Pearl pass — the moonstone shell vibrates harder the deeper she goes, and ahead she can see a MASSIVE pile of shells someone stacked on purpose to block the way. Shell barricade or spring passage?

m1.text: The deep spring is RIGHT THERE glowing like captured moonlight and the star-seed is flickering so fast it might go out any second — the singing pearl is hitting the highest note Pearl has ever heard, practically screaming HURRY. Coral staircase or lily pad?

m2.text: Pearl can SEE the deep spring from up here and it is GORGEOUS — pure white light beaming up from below, but the star-seed is fading fast and the singing pearl's note is getting wobbly, which probably means they are running out of time. Rope bridge or coral slide?

m3.text: The hermit crab SLAMS the shell gap shut and Pearl can hear him muttering about protecting the spring — the moonstone shell vibrates near the bubble tubes and they START GURGLING, ready to fire! Rapid tiny bubbles, one massive bubble, or spiral stream?

m4.text: Pearl sneaks around the fortress and finds the crab from behind — he is NOT fearsome at all, just a scared little guy surrounded by broken shells, and his eyes go wide when he sees the star-seed glowing in Pearl's satchel. Lantern sculpture or spring pool?

end_spring_bloom.text: Pearl raced down the stairs and pressed the star-seed into the spring just as it flickered its LAST flicker — the water ERUPTED in a fountain of starlight so bright that every coral in the lagoon lit up like a birthday cake! The singing pearl chimed one perfect triumphant note and the hermit crab peeked out crying because the spring was HEALING just like it used to before it got polluted. He tore down his own fortress and became Pearl's defender on the swim home. The End!

end_seed_fade.text: Pearl leaped onto the lily pad but it started SINKING and she had to hold the star-seed up to keep it dry — by the time she scrambled to the center the seed had gone completely dark and cold like a tiny pebble. The singing pearl went silent, the lagoon dimmed, and Pearl sat on a sinking lily pad holding a regular old rock. Oopsie ending!

end_coral_light.text: Pearl crossed the bridge and the singing pearl told her EXACTLY when to drop — the star-seed fell in a perfect golden arc and hit the spring with a FLASH so bright the whole cavern turned into a rainbow cathedral! The starfish all pointed at the light like tiny golden arrows and even the hermit crab came out of his fortress blinking because the spring was glowing clean and healthy again. He apologized for the barricade and promised to guard the spring FOR Pearl from now on. The End!

end_current_pull.text: Pearl zoomed down the slide WAY too fast and splashed into a current that grabbed her like a water roller coaster with no brakes — the singing pearl bounced away into the dark and the star-seed slipped out of her paws and got carried off by the current into who-knows-where! Pearl washed up on a beach three coves over, soaking wet, star-seedless, and pearl-less. Oopsie ending!

end_tiny_tickle.text: Pearl fired the tiny bubbles and they tickled the crab SO MUCH he fell out of his fortress laughing — turns out he built the whole thing because the last visitor POLLUTED the spring and his family got sick, and he was just trying to protect it! Pearl showed him the star-seed and he cried happy tears because it HEALS water. He helped her plant it and the spring exploded with light. Best bubble battle ever. The End!

end_mega_lift.text: The massive bubble was SO massive it lifted Pearl AND the fortress into the air — she clung to the bubble like a beach ball while the star-seed flickered uselessly in her satchel far above the spring! The bubble bounced off the cave ceiling, popped with a tremendous SPLAT, and Pearl landed in a pile of scattered shells while the crab facepalmed with both claws. Oopsie ending!

end_spiral_heal.text: The spiral stream squeezed through every crack in the fortress and carried star-seed sparkle STRAIGHT into the spring — the water erupted in spiraling ribbons of color and the crab came out in total shock because the spring was CLEAN again! He confessed he built the fortress because a visitor polluted it and his babies got sick. Pearl hugged him and said the star heals everything. He tore down his own walls and carried Pearl on his shell all the way home. The End!

end_shell_peace.text: Pearl showed the crab the star-seed and his whole face changed — he told her a visitor polluted the spring and his babies got sick, so he built the fortress to keep EVERYONE out because he was too scared to trust anyone again. The star-seed's glow touched the wilted flowers and they sprang back to life. The crab started crying, tore down his own fortress, and walked Pearl to the spring himself. They planted the seed together and the lagoon lit up like a thousand stars. The End!

end_crab_defender.text: Pearl tried to step past the crab but he panicked and grabbed her satchel — the star-seed bounced out and rolled across the rocks like the world's most important marble! Pearl and the crab both dove for it at the same time, bonked heads, and watched the seed roll into a crack between two boulders where NEITHER of them could reach it. They spent the rest of the night trying to fish it out with sticks. Oopsie ending!

start.text: Somewhere deep in this sparkly quarry hides the legendary echo gem — the ONE crystal that barks back a PERFECT bark instead of the garbled meow-quack-kazoo nonsense the regular crystals spit out. Pip's tail is already wagging at competition speed. Amethyst tunnel or citrine passage?

a.text: Pip barked HELLO and the amethyst walls fired it back as a startled MEOW, which is frankly insulting — but that sparkly amethyst shard on the ledge buzzed so hard it basically jumped into his collar all by itself. Crystal grotto or geode bridge?

scare.reveal: Relax cousin! Just moonlight through old bones — happens every full moon!

t.ja: いとこ、リラックスして！ ふるい ほね を とおる つきあかり だよ！ まんげつ の たび に おこる こと な の！
t.cmn: 放松点，亲爱的！ 只是月光穿过旧骨头！ 每个满月都会发生哦！
t.yue: 放鬆啲啦，表哥！ 只係月光穿過啲舊骨頭啫！ 每個滿月都會發生㗎！

b.text: Pip tried a tiny test bark and the citrine walls bounced it back as a QUACK so loud three crystals rattled — not the kind of fame he was hoping for. A golden citrine pebble on the shelf hummed when he barked, so into the collar it went. Quartz staircase or crystal chute?

aa.text: Every stalactite drip made a tiny PLINK that the grotto turned into a full orchestra, and the amethyst shard in Pip's collar hummed along like the world's tiniest conductor — this place is DEFINITELY hiding something sparkly. Crystal cluster or quartz arch?

ab.text: Each geode half went ZING under Pip's paws like the world's most extra stepping stones, and halfway across his amethyst shard hummed a note so pretty the whole bridge hummed back. Jade ledge or coral archway?

ba.text: Every step played a BONNNNG under Pip's paws like a crystal xylophone and his bark came back as a KAZOO — honestly an improvement over quacking — while the citrine pebble practically bounced on his collar. Teal boulder or amber shelf?

bb.text: Pip went down that chute so fast his ears flapped like flags and his bark stretched into a WOOOOO that the crystals helpfully replayed as a tuba — not graceful but the citrine pebble somehow stayed put. Jade column or calcite shelf?

scare.reveal: Oh my! Nobody has visited this wall in a thousand years! How exciting!

t.ja: あらま！ この かべ、せんねん も だれも きてない よ！ わくわく する ね！
t.cmn: 哎呀！ 这面墙一千年都没人来过啦！ 太让人兴奋啦！
t.yue: 哎呀！ 呢幅牆一千年都冇人嚟過㗎！ 好刺激呀！

m1.text: The lavender cluster HUMMED and Pip's amethyst shard BUZZED right back like they were having a private chat he was absolutely not invited to — and that purple moss patch looks SUSPICIOUSLY comfortable for a cave with work to do. Singing bowl or moss patch?

m2.text: Under the arch Pip's tiniest sniff echoed into a WHOOSH and his amethyst shard glowed pink and sang a note so clear it sounded like his OWN bark from last Tuesday — and that amber ledge is glinting like the world's biggest butterscotch. Emerald stalagmite or amber ledge?

m3.text: Three crystals humming BRMMM and DINNNG and CHIMMME, and the citrine pebble is basically beatboxing on Pip's collar — each crystal hums LOUDER when he steps closer like a sparkly audition lineup. Amethyst spire, citrine column, or quartz pillar?

m4.text: Every geode was whispering a tiny WOOF and Pip's ears kept swiveling like satellite dishes because those woofs sounded EXACTLY like his — is this quarry seriously a Pip jukebox? Sapphire geode or calcite tower?

end_echo_chorus.text: Pip BONKED that singing bowl and the whole cavern lit up like a concert hall — every crystal sang his bark back in PERFECT harmony, hundreds of them, years of happy barks stored in stone like the world's sparkliest jukebox! The echo gem was never one crystal. It was ALL of them, the whole quarry, singing Pip's song right back at him. The End!

end_puddle_pup.text: That moss was SO unbelievably soft that Pip's eyes closed and his tail stopped wagging for the first time in recorded puppy history — he dreamed about barking on the meadow while the echo gem waited patiently somewhere deeper for a hero with more stamina and less interest in luxury napping. Oopsie ending!

end_arch_song.text: Pip pressed his paws to the stalagmite and the arch ROARED with sound — every bark he had ever barked on the meadow above came pouring out of the walls in layers, years and years of happy puppy! The echo gem was the whole quarry and it had been learning his song since he was a pup with ears too big for his head. The End!

end_crystal_tongue.text: Pip thought that amber ledge looked DELICIOUS and licked it and his tongue stuck faster than gum on a boot — every muffled yelp bounced through the arch sounding sillier and sillier while Pip dangled there like a sparkly golden ornament. The echo gem is somewhere nearby probably taking notes on his funniest sounds yet. Oopsie ending!

end_amethyst_chord.text: Pip booped the amethyst spire and the dome THUNDERED with the deepest most magnificent chord any puppy has ever accidentally produced — years of stored barks humming through every crystal vein like the mountain itself was singing along! The echo gem was never one crystal. It was the whole quarry, rehearsing Pip's greatest hits this entire time. The End!

end_citrine_duet.text: Pip touched the citrine column and it barked back — but SO loud that it bounced off every crystal in the dome and came back as a THOUSAND barks at once! The noise was so enormous that Pip's ears went flat, the pebble in his collar vibrated right off, and he ran for the exit with the loudest bark-echo in geological history chasing him down the tunnel. Oopsie ending!

end_quartz_harmony.text: Pip leaned against the pillar a little too hard and it WOBBLED — every crystal in the cavern gasped (which for crystals sounds like a very high-pitched eeeeee) and went completely silent! Pip backed away very slowly, the pillar settled with a groan, and the cavern gave him the most disapproving silence a bunch of rocks has ever produced. Oopsie ending!

end_geode_song.text: Pip barked into the sapphire geode and a hundred geodes barked BACK — his excited bark, his sleepy bark, his dinner bark, his suspicious-squirrel bark — all stored in crystal for YEARS like the world's most dedicated fan club! The echo gem was the whole gallery and it knew every bark Pip had ever barked. The End!

end_calcite_tower.text: Pip tipped his head back and HOWLED at that calcite tower and it answered with every bark it had ever caught drifting down from the meadow — puppy barks, grown-up barks, the time he barked at his own shadow, ALL of them stacked in orange stone like a crystal encyclopedia of Pip! The End!

start.text: Something deep in the caves is SINGING and it sounds exactly like Pearl's lost cousin who vanished into these caves last full moon — the tide is rising and the caves flood chamber by chamber, so standing here debating is NOT an option. Crystal tunnel or coral passage?

a.text: The singing is LOUDER in here and Pearl finds a conch shell stuck between two crystals that hums the same melody — she holds it to her ear and it whispers directions, which is creepy but helpful. The water is at her ankles and rising FAST. Stalactite chamber or phosphor pool?

b.text: The coral walls are SO bright they make Pearl's fur look pink and sitting on a ledge is a tiny lantern made of LIVING coral that pulses warm light in time with the singing — definitely going in the satchel, definitely not asking questions about alive lanterns. Current channel or coral arch?

aa.text: The stalactites are VIBRATING with the singing and the echo conch is practically screaming directions — the water is at Pearl's knees now and two paths go deeper, one echoing with song and one leading to trapped air pockets above. Echo hall or air shaft?

ab.text: The phosphor pool is beautiful but something underneath keeps tugging at the water — the echo conch hums a warning note and Pearl decides NOT to put her paws in the glowy green mystery liquid. The water is rising and the singing is getting CLOSER. Song corridor or breathing chamber?

scare.reveal: Been saving this for someone! Take it!

t.ja: だれか の ため に とっておいた の！ どうぞ！
t.cmn: 我一直为某人留着这个呢！ 拿着吧！
t.yue: 我一直都幫人留起呢個㗎！ 攞去啦！

ba.text: The current is STRONG and Pearl has to grab the walls to keep from being swept — the glow lantern blazes brighter the deeper she goes, and the singing is coming from a massive dark chamber ahead that feels like it is BREATHING. Grotto entrance or sand bank?

bb.text: The walls are PULSING like a heartbeat and Pearl can feel it in her chest — the glow lantern pulses in the same rhythm and the singing is so loud now it fills the water like it is coming from the ROCKS themselves. Cavern mouth or tidal ledge?

scare.reveal: Just the cave's heartbeat monitor! All healthy!

t.ja: どうくつ の しんぱくけい だ よ！ ぜんぶ けんこう！
t.cmn: 只是洞穴的心跳监测器！ 一切都健康！
t.yue: 只係個山窿嘅心跳監測器啫！ 全部都好健康呀！

m1.text: The echo conch and the singing voice are hitting the EXACT same note and the water is vibrating — Pearl can see a glowing white grotto where the voice might be, but the water is at her CHEST and one of these passages leads deeper underwater. White grotto or dark tunnel?

m2.text: Pearl can finally BREATHE in here and the echo conch makes the whole dome ring like a bell — the singing voice bounces around so much she cannot tell which direction it comes from, but the rose crystal is humming the same note and that whirlpool is pulling water somewhere DEEP. Rose crystal or whirlpool?

m3.text: It is NOT her cousin singing — it is the CAVE! The entire grotto is a living coral creature and it has been singing to lure sea-dragons here for warmth because it is LONELY. The glow lantern in Pearl's satchel is pulsing like a heartbeat and the grotto's huge gentle face looks so sad. Coral alcove, crystal spire, or moonlit pool?

m4.text: Two giant eels are having a WATER-SQUIRT SHOWDOWN right in front of the only two tunnels deeper — the cyan one guards the high tunnel above water and the magenta one guards the low tunnel underwater. The glow lantern makes them both pause and blink. Pick a side!

end_song_found.text: Pearl swam into the white grotto and found the singer — the cave ITSELF, a living coral creature who had been singing for YEARS trying to lure sea-dragons because it was lonely and cold! The echo conch harmonized with its voice and for the first time the grotto heard someone sing BACK. Pearl taught it to sing above the waterline so sailors and whales could hear it too. Now the singing caves have visitors every day and the grotto is never lonely again. The End!

end_flood_rush.text: Pearl dove into the dark tunnel and the current grabbed her IMMEDIATELY — she tumbled head over tail in pitch-black water, lost the echo conch, lost all sense of direction, and washed up in a dead-end chamber with the water rising to the ceiling! She managed to squeeze through a tiny crack and pop out on the beach coughing and sputtering. The singing caves are still singing but Pearl is NOT going back in today. Oopsie ending!

end_harmony_ring.text: Pearl touched the crystal and the echo conch SANG — the whole dome rang like the world's biggest bell and the sound traveled through every tunnel lighting up the walls one by one! It reached the deepest grotto and the singing cave — a lonely living coral creature — opened its eyes because for the FIRST time someone answered its song with harmony instead of fear. Pearl followed the lit-up path and taught the grotto to sing above the waterline. Now ships follow the melody home on foggy nights. The End!

end_echo_trap.text: Pearl jumped into the whirlpool and it spun her around so fast she could not tell up from down — the echo conch flew away, the singing voice echoed from EVERYWHERE at once, and she ended up in a deep rocky basin with absolutely no idea which way was up. A friendly crab eventually showed her a side exit but she popped out three beaches away covered in seaweed with her ears still ringing. Oopsie ending!

end_coral_duet.text: Pearl sat down in the coral alcove and started singing — the grotto's huge gentle face lit up because nobody had ever sung WITH it before! They sang a duet that echoed through every chamber and the grotto was so happy it stopped pulling things underwater and learned to sing above the waterline. Pearl visits every full moon for their duet and the caves glow warmest on those nights. The End!

end_warm_glow.text: Pearl climbed the spire and held the glow lantern as HIGH as she could — the living coral blazed and filled the grotto with warmth for the first time since the sea-dragons stopped coming! The grotto's sad face transformed into the biggest smile Pearl had ever seen on a cave. It did not need sea-dragons — it needed a friend with a warm heart. Pearl taught it to sing above the waterline and now the caves glow warm enough to heat the whole lagoon. The End!

end_surface_song.text: Pearl stepped into the pool and her paw slipped on a mossy rock — SPLASH went Pearl, HISSS went the lantern, and the whole cave went DARK! She paddled around in the pitch black bumping into coral walls while the grotto tried to sing her directions but Pearl was too busy gargling water to hear them. She finally crawled out on the wrong beach, soaking wet and completely lantern-less. Oopsie ending!

end_high_ride.text: Pearl faked left and dashed right and the cyan eel was SO impressed it shot a water jet that LAUNCHED her through the high tunnel like a rocket — she burst into the deepest grotto at full speed and the singing cave stopped mid-note in total surprise! Nobody had ever arrived with that much style. Pearl caught her breath, explained she came to find the singer, and taught the lonely grotto to sing above the waterline so it would never need to lure anyone underground again. The End!

end_low_glide.text: Pearl dove and the magenta eel's current was WAY too strong — it flipped her upside down and sent her tumbling through the dark like laundry in a washing machine! The lantern sank into a crack, the satchel filled with sand, and she popped out in a random tide pool with kelp on her head and absolutely no idea where the singing grotto was. The eel waved goodbye from the tunnel. Oopsie ending!

start.text: Rex opened his mouth to yawn and out came the BIGGEST accidental roar that ever roared — now it's bouncing off every canyon wall and getting LOUDER. He has to reach the Echo Stone and roar the counter-frequency before the whole desert shakes apart! Slot canyon or mesa arch?

a.text: The slot canyon squeezed Rex's roar into a SQUEAL like a dinosaur stepping on a squeaky toy — embarrassing! But that turquoise singing stone on the ledge hummed back so sweetly Rex tucked it under his arm. Blue grotto or sandstone bridge?

b.text: Under the mesa arch Rex's echo bounced so hard pebbles rained down like confetti at a VERY loud party — but that terracotta wind-chime jingled the OPPOSITE sound and canceled the echo for one beautiful second. Rex grabbed it. Sienna staircase or red slot canyon?

choices.label: Duck into the red slot canyon

aa.text: The grotto turned Rex's breathing into a SYMPHONY and the singing stone hummed along like it knew every note — somewhere close the Echo Stone must be listening. Echo bell or crystal alcove?

ab.text: The bridge WOBBLED with every echo-bounce and Rex's singing stone vibrated so hard it nearly wiggled free — whatever is making all this noise is CLOSE and probably enormous. Turquoise boulder or mesa ledge?

ba.text: Each step BONGED under Rex's feet and the wind-chime jingled the cancel-note just in time — but the ground at the bottom keeps rumbling and that armadillo barricade looks VERY intentional. Armadillo barricade or rust cave?

bb.text: This slot canyon was so tight Rex's echo squeezed into a WHISPER for once — the wind-chime barely had to cancel anything! But ahead the canyon opens into something BIG and echoey. Tan boulder or sienna tunnel?

m1.text: There it is — the golden Echo Stone! It's practically SHAKING with Rex's trapped roar. One big counter-roar should shut it down — but the singing stone keeps humming toward that gentle crystal pool like it knows something Rex doesn't. Roar at the Echo Stone or dip the singing stone in the pool?

choices.label: Dip the stone in the pool

m2.text: The armadillo captain tapped her helmet and pointed at the amphitheater — THIS is where Rex proves he can cancel his echo without scrambling every egg in the canyon. Canyon horn or drumstone?

m3.text: The armadillo captain rolled onto the stage and declared ROAR CONTEST! Rex can blow the deep bass horn, screech into the screech pipe, or squeeze that suspicious little cactus. Bass horn, screech pipe, or squeaky cactus?

m4.text: Rex's jaw DROPPED — armadillo EGGS everywhere, and they're shaking with every echo-bounce! No WONDER the armadillos are so grumpy about noise. The wind-chime is keeping things calm but Rex needs to be super careful. Big golden egg or spotted eggs?

end_gentle_hum.text: Rex dipped the singing stone and the pool sang the gentlest hum — the Echo Stone LISTENED, the trapped roar melted away like butter on a hot rock, and the armadillo captain saluted from the entrance because NOT A SINGLE EGG CRACKED. Gentle beats loud every time. The End!

end_full_blast.text: Rex's mega-roar hit the Echo Stone so hard every wall in the canyon CRACKED and the echo got TEN TIMES LOUDER — now there are a HUNDRED roars bouncing around like the world's worst concert and Rex is going to need a LOT more singing stones. Oopsie ending!

end_canyon_chorus.text: Rex blew that horn and the armadillo captain whipped out a HARMONICA — together they played the counter-frequency so beautifully the whole canyon hummed along, the echo melted, the eggs stopped shaking, and Rex learned the best roar is sometimes a duet. The End!

end_mesa_dance.text: Rex STOMPED so hard the drumstone cracked clean in half and he tumbled straight into a sand dune — the echo bounced off the broken stone TEN TIMES HARDER and now every armadillo is giving him the stink-eye from behind their tiny helmets while he spits out sand. Turns out the counter-frequency is NOT a stomp. Oopsie ending!

end_low_rumble.text: Rex blew that bass horn and a RUMBLE so deep it made his bones buzz rolled through the amphitheater — every armadillo nodded, the captain taught him the secret gentle counter-hum, and Rex walked out humming so softly not a single egg even wobbled. The End!

end_high_screech.text: Rex SCREECHED so hard the pipe shot sparks and every armadillo curled into a ball and rolled offstage — stalactites cracked, the echo got SCREECHY too, and somewhere in the caves the eggs were vibrating like maracas. NOT the counter-frequency. Oopsie ending!

end_surprise_squeak.text: Rex squeezed that cactus and out came the TINIEST most ridiculous squeak — armadillos laughed so hard they fell off their seats, the echo hiccupped and shrank, and the captain was laughing too hard to be grumpy anymore! The counter-frequency to a big scary roar is one very silly squeak. The End!

end_egg_lullaby.text: Rex hummed the softest deepest lullaby a dinosaur ever hummed and the golden egg GLOWED — every egg in the cave stopped shaking, the armadillo captain cried actual armadillo tears, and she taught Rex the exact counter-frequency because anyone who hums THAT gently deserves to save the canyon. The End!

end_tail_thump.text: Rex tiptoed like a champion but his tail had OTHER PLANS — THWACK went the platform and eggs rolled everywhere like the world's most stressful bowling alley! Rex spent the rest of the afternoon returning eggs to nests while armadillos supervised with VERY judgmental expressions. Oopsie ending!

start.text: Luna's horn is flickering like a candle in a breeze and the Moon Pool is somewhere deep inside this bamboo maze — dawn is sneaking closer and if her horn goes dark she will be wandering in circles until breakfast. Lantern trail or moonbeam trail?

a.text: The lanterns bob along like they KNOW the way and hanging from a bamboo branch Luna finds a tiny glowing lantern charm that hums when she touches it — into her mane it goes because enchanted jewelry is always a good sign. Bamboo tunnel or stepping-stones?

scare.reveal: Just stretching my wings in the moonlight!

t.ja: つきあかり の なか で はね を のばしてる だけ！
t.cmn: 只是在月光下伸展翅膀呢！
t.yue: 只係喺月光下伸吓翼啫！

b.text: The moonbeams land in perfect pools like someone is AIMING them and inside a hollow bamboo cup Luna finds a moonstone pebble that glows warm when she picks it up — tucked behind her ear it goes because pockets are hard when you are a unicorn. Firefly archway or stone garden?

aa.text: The moss curtains part like they were waiting for Luna and the lantern charm hums along with a melody coming from deeper inside the maze — somewhere ahead something is SINGING and it sounds like moonlight would if moonlight had a voice. Paper screen or bamboo bridge?

ab.text: The koi follow Luna's lantern charm like it is their favorite nightlight and on the far bank the stream splits into two paths — one smells like warm sand and the other like wisteria blossoms which is a very fancy way of saying BOTH smell amazing. Sand clearing or torii arch?

ba.text: The fireflies swirl around Luna's horn like they are trying to tell her something and the moonstone pebble behind her ear gets WARM whenever she faces the right direction — there is definitely something magical happening deeper in this maze. Wind chime tree or bamboo fountain?

choices.label: Listen at the wind chime tree

bb.text: Every fox statue seems to be watching Luna from the corner of its stone eyes which is VERY unsettling for a garden and the moonstone pebble flashes bright blue whenever she turns toward the center — something is definitely hiding here. Bronze gong or moss mound?

m1.text: The Moon Pool is RIGHT THERE but the tanuki has made five copies of itself and they are ALL waving which is adorable but EXTREMELY unhelpful — the lantern charm is buzzing like it knows which path is real. Bamboo arch or blossom carpet?

m2.text: Luna can SEE the Moon Pool shimmering far below through a gap in the bamboo and the lantern charm is pointing straight down like a tiny compass — go through the waterfall or climb the tower to catch the moon from above. Waterfall or tower?

m3.text: SPARKLE-HORN DUEL — the tanuki is blocking all three paths with copies of itself and Luna's horn is CRACKLING with enough sparkle energy for exactly ONE blast. Flash-blind to dazzle them, strobe-pulse to find the real one, or steady-beam to see through the trick?

m4.text: Wait — the fountain is playing the SAME song the lanterns have been humming this whole time and the bamboo walls are swaying like they want to dance — maybe the trick is not to look harder but to LISTEN. Follow the song or push through the thicket?

end_lantern_arch.text: Luna charged through the bamboo arch and the lantern charm blazed so bright that every fake tanuki popped like a soap bubble — she dipped her horn into the Moon Pool and it ROARED back to life brighter than ever! The tanuki clapped and said THAT is how you navigate a maze — trust the light that chose you. The End!

end_blossom_lost.text: Luna followed the pretty blossoms and they led her in a GIANT circle — round and round while the petals piled up to her knees and the Moon Pool got farther away with every step! By the time dawn arrived her horn was completely dark and she was standing in a mountain of pink petals looking very confused and very sparkle-less. Oopsie ending!

end_waterfall_pool.text: Luna jumped straight through the waterfall and behind it was the most beautiful hidden grotto with the Moon Pool glowing like liquid moonlight — she dipped her horn in and it blazed back BRIGHTER than a shooting star! A swirl of fireflies danced around her and the tanuki called from above that anyone brave enough to jump through a waterfall deserves the brightest horn in the forest. The End!

end_tower_moonbath.text: Luna climbed the tower but bamboo is BENDY — the whole top section flexed like a catapult and FLUNG her over the canopy! She landed upside down in a thicket with her hooves tangled in bamboo and the lantern charm somewhere in the leaves below. The tanuki peeked up and said that is NOT how towers work. Oopsie ending!

end_flash_dazzle.text: Luna fired the BIGGEST flash and it bounced off all three tanukis like a mirror ball — straight back into her OWN eyes! She stumbled around seeing spots, tripped over a root, and sat there blinking while every single tanuki waved cheerfully. The moonstone pebble rolled away and the tanuki said THAT is why you do not out-sparkle a trickster. Oopsie ending!

end_strobe_reveal.text: Luna's horn pulsed STROBE STROBE STROBE and with each flash a fake tanuki vanished until only the real one stood there looking genuinely surprised that someone figured out his trick — he bowed so deep his leaf fell off and said THAT is the cleverest horn-work he had seen in a hundred moons! The walls parted and the Moon Pool was right there waiting. The End!

end_steady_truth.text: Luna held a steady blue beam and swept it across the arena like a lantern — the fake tanukis turned transparent and melted away and the real one just sat there with the most peaceful smile, saying that patience was the hardest lesson the maze could teach and Luna had passed without even trying! The walls dissolved and the Moon Pool opened wide and warm. The End!

end_song_heart.text: Luna closed her eyes and followed the song — the bamboo walls PARTED before every step like they had been waiting for someone to finally listen instead of look! The tanuki was crying actual happy tears and said he had been guarding this maze for a hundred years waiting for someone wise enough to navigate by HEART instead of sight. Luna dipped her horn in the Moon Pool and it glowed warmer than it ever had before. The End!

end_thicket_tangle.text: Luna shoved into the thicket and the bamboo grabbed on like it had opinions about shortcuts — every step got more tangled and the lanterns' song got quieter until she was stuck up to her ears in purple bamboo with her horn completely dark and dawn happening without her. The tanuki sighed from somewhere above and said THAT is what happens when you stop listening. Oopsie ending!

start.text: Something is HOWLING from the deepest part of the scrapyard and it sounds like a puppy in trouble — Pip's ears are standing straight up and his tail is wagging because rescuing things is his absolute favorite activity especially when it is midnight and slightly terrifying. Car canyon or appliance alley?

a.text: The cars creak and groan like metal dinosaurs and hanging from a mirror Pip finds a red magnet on a string that CLICKS onto everything metal — into the satchel it goes because in a scrapyard a magnet is basically a magic wand. Drum bridge or tire mountain?

scare.reveal: Whoa! Just testing my battle outfit!

t.ja: わあ！ たたかい の ふく を ためしてる だけ！
t.cmn: 哇！ 只是在测试我的战斗服！
t.yue: 嘩！ 只係試緊我套戰鬥衫啫！

b.text: Every washing machine looks like a robot face staring at Pip which is not creepy at ALL and hanging from a dryer handle he finds a brass bell that makes the prettiest chime when he taps it — into the satchel because musical things are always important in stories. Tin roof path or bathtub?

aa.text: The drums boom like thunder with every step and the magnet keeps sticking to things which makes sneaking EXTREMELY loud — the howling is so close now that Pip can feel it in his chest and whatever is making that sound needs help right NOW. Truck cab or school bus?

ab.text: Pip climbs the tires and from the top he can see the WHOLE scrapyard spread out in the moonlight like a metal mountain range — the howling is coming from a dark spot just below and his magnet is practically vibrating with excitement. Bumper ledge or tarp slide?

ba.text: The tin roof goes CLONG CLONG CLONG with every step which is basically announcing HEY EVERYONE PIP IS HERE and the howling ahead sounds SO sad — the brass bell chimes back at the howling like they are having a conversation. Pipe maze or wheel archway?

bb.text: The bathtub is actually an EXCELLENT lookout post and Pip can see deeper into the scrapyard from here — the howling is definitely coming from the other side of that big junk wall and the brass bell chimes encouragingly like a tiny cheerleader. Radiator stack or hubcap trail?

m1.text: The howling is RIGHT behind this wall and the magnet is pulling so hard Pip's whole arm is stretching — grab the crane hook to swing over or topple the hubcap tower to punch through. Crane hook or hubcap tower?

m2.text: Pip can see a faint glow at the bottom of the hollow where the howling is loudest and the magnet is pointing straight down like a compass — careful ladder climb or wild pipe slide. Fire escape or drainpipe?

m3.text: MUD-BALL SIEGE — a scarred tom-cat the size of a watermelon blocks every path wearing a dented tin can like armor and looking EXTREMELY unimpressed. Pip has mud and determination. High lob over the top, fast roll at the shield, or sneak around the side?

m4.text: There is NO puppy — the howling is coming from a broken wind-up music box shaped like a dog and behind the tom-cat's tough-guy act is a cozy shelter full of sleeping KITTENS! The brass bell chimes and the music box rattles like they recognize each other. Kitten shelter or music box?

end_crane_rescue.text: Pip swung over on the crane hook like a tiny action hero and landed right next to the music box — the magnet clicked onto the jammed gear and it popped free with a PING! The most beautiful lullaby started playing and the tom-cat appeared with actual tears because he had been trying to fix that melody for MONTHS. Turns out the tough old cat was sheltering a whole family of stray kittens and the music box was their bedtime song. The End!

end_hubcap_avalanche.text: Pip toppled the hubcap tower and it crashed down like the world's loudest cymbal solo — CLANG BANG CRASH — burying him in a pile of spinning hubcaps while the magnet stuck to ALL of them at once and turned him into a metal hedgehog! The wall did not budge, the howling stopped in confusion, and the tom-cat just stared down with his arms crossed. Oopsie ending!

end_ladder_discovery.text: Pip climbed down carefully and found the music box right where the magnet pointed — it was NOT a puppy at all but a wind-up dog with a jammed gear and Pip's small paw was EXACTLY the right size to reach inside and turn it! The sweetest lullaby filled the hollow and the tom-cat appeared behind him looking ten years younger. He had been trying to fix it for months because the melody was the only thing that calmed his scared stray kittens. The End!

end_pipe_tumble.text: Pip shot down that pipe like a cannonball and LAUNCHED into a mountain of soggy cardboard boxes — completely soaked, covered in packing peanuts, and somehow FURTHER from the howling than when he started! The magnet flew away and stuck to a pipe on the other side of the yard and the mysterious howl will have to wait for a less dramatic rescue attempt. Oopsie ending!

end_lob_splat.text: Pip lobbed the mud ball in a PERFECT arc and it splattered right on the tom-cat's tin can armor from above — SPLORCH! The old cat looked down at the mud, looked at Pip, and burst out laughing so hard he nearly fell over. Nobody had ever out-lobbed him before! He stepped aside and showed Pip his secret — a shelter full of kittens and a broken music box he could not fix. Pip's small paws reached the jammed gear and the sweetest lullaby filled the scrapyard while the brass bell chimed along. The End!

end_roll_clang.text: Pip rolled the mud ball SO fast it hit a rock and bounced right back into his own FACE — SPLAT! He stumbled backward blinded by mud, got his satchel hooked on a fridge handle, and dangled there like a very muddy Christmas ornament while the tom-cat just stared at him. The brass bell clanged helpfully but Pip could not see, could not move, and smelled like wet dirt. Oopsie ending!

end_sneak_kittens.text: Pip snuck around the side and tumbled right into the SECRET — a cozy shelter full of the cutest kittens he had ever seen all blinking up at him! The howling was just a broken music box shaped like a dog and the tom-cat appeared behind him looking SHOCKED that someone found his hiding spot. Pip reached his small paw into the music box, turned the jammed gear, and the brass bell and lullaby harmonized so sweetly that every kitten purred and the old tom-cat whispered thank you. The End!

end_kitten_lullaby.text: Pip shook the brass bell softly and every kitten stopped squirming and curled up like the chime was their favorite sound — then he reached over and fixed the music box gear and the bell and the lullaby played together in the most beautiful harmony! The tom-cat sat down beside Pip and said he had been guarding these kittens alone for months and nobody had ever been kind enough to come help. Sometimes the bravest rescue is a gentle one. The End!

end_gear_fix.text: Pip reached inside the music box and the gear SPRANG loose with a BOING — a tiny coil bonked him on the nose and the box honked ONE horrible note before going totally dead! Every kitten woke up crying and the tom-cat rushed in looking like someone had just broken his most precious thing, which is exactly what happened. Pip held the broken spring and whispered sorry about forty times. Oopsie ending!

cmn.sayFound: 小飞龙大口吃掉，开心地吐出一个小烟圈！
cmn.sayLocked: 小飞龙的肚子咕咕叫了…

yue.sayFound: 龍仔食晒啦，仲開心咁噴咗個煙圈仔添！
yue.sayLocked: 小飛龍個肚仔咕咕聲呀…

nameT.ja: ドラゴン の あさごはん

ja.intro: あかちゃん ドラゴン おなかが すいてて とべないよ！ おいしいもの みつけて あさごはん つくってあげよう。
ja.winText: もぐもぐ！ あかちゃん ドラゴン おなかいっぱい！ また びゅーんって とんでるよ！

cmn.intro: 小飞龙太饿了，飞不动啦！快找些好吃的，给他做早餐吧。
cmn.winText: 嗯！小飞龙吃饱了，又可以飞啦！

yue.intro: 小飛龍太肚餓啦，飛唔到呀！快啲搵啲好嘢食，煮早餐俾佢啦。
yue.winText: 嘩！小飛龍食飽飽啦，又可以飛嚟飛去啦！

escape.name: The Pelican Trade
escape.intro: A treasure chest washed up on the beach, but it will not open! Look around the cove for a way in.
escape.winText: Treasure! You are the cleverest little pirate!

t.ja: くねくね おさかな！
ぴかぴか の かい！

ja.sayFound: くねくね おさかな！

hotspots.saySearch: Just a shady spot. Nothing hidden here!

ja.saySearch: ただ の ひかげ だね。 ここ には なにも ないよ！

cmn.saySearch: 只是一个阴凉的地方。 这里什么也没藏！

yue.saySearch: 只係一個陰涼嘅地方。 呢度冇嘢收埋㗎！

hotspots.sayFound: The pelican trades you a shiny shell!
hotspots.sayLocked: The pelican wants a snack first…

ja.sayFound: ペリカン が ぴかぴか の かい を くれたよ！
ja.sayLocked: ペリカン さん、まず おやつ が ほしいって！

cmn.sayFound: 鹈鹕跟你交换了一个闪亮的贝壳！

yue.sayFound: 塘鵝同你交換咗個閃閃嘅貝殼呀！

hotspots.sayFound: The chest bursts open — treasure for everyone!
hotspots.sayLocked: The treasure chest has a shell-shaped slot!

ja.sayFound: たからばこ が パカッと あいた！ みんな の おたから だ！
ja.sayLocked: たからばこ には かい の かたち の あな が あるよ！

cmn.sayFound: 宝箱砰地一声打开了！ 大家都有宝藏了！
cmn.sayLocked: 宝箱上有一个贝壳形状的槽！

yue.sayFound: 個寶箱砰一聲開咗啦！ 大家都有寶藏啦！
yue.sayLocked: 個寶箱有個貝殼形狀嘅窿呀！

nameT.ja: ペリカン の こうかん

ja.intro: たからばこ が きた けど あかない！ まわり を さがして みて！
ja.winText: おたから！ ちっちゃな かいぞくさん、かしこいね！

cmn.intro: 一个宝箱冲上岸了，可是打不开！ 快在海湾附近找找看！
cmn.winText: 宝藏！ 你真是最聪明的小海盗！

yue.intro: 有個寶箱沖咗上岸，但係開唔到！ 快啲喺海灣附近搵吓啦！
yue.winText: 寶藏呀！ 你係最叻嘅小海盜呀！

escape.name: Bunny Blast-Off
escape.intro: The bunny's rocket will not start! Find what it needs and help her blast off to the moon.
escape.winText: Whoosh! The bunny zooms to the moon — thanks to you!

t.ja: じょうぶな レンチ！
すごい でんち！

ja.sayFound: じょうぶな レンチ！

hotspots.sayFound: A super battery was inside the crate!

ja.sayFound: はこの なかに すごい でんちが あった！

cmn.sayFound: 箱子里有一个超级电池！

yue.sayFound: 個箱入面有粒超級電芯！

hotspots.saySearch: That is where the bunny wants to go!

ja.saySearch: うさぎさん ここに いきたいんだね！

hotspots.sayFound: The wrench pops the panel open — there is an empty battery slot inside!
hotspots.sayLocked: The rocket panel is stuck. We need a tool to open it!

ja.sayFound: レンチで パネルが パカッと あいた！ でんちの スロットが からっぽだ！
ja.sayLocked: ロケットの パネル あかない。 どうぐが いるね！

cmn.sayFound: 扳手把面板撬开了！里面有个空的电池槽！
cmn.sayLocked: 火箭面板卡住了。 我们需要工具来打开它！

yue.sayFound: 士巴拿撬開咗塊板！入面有個空嘅電池位！
yue.sayLocked: 火箭塊板卡住咗。 我哋要搵工具嚟開佢！

hotspots.sayFound: The battery clicks in — three, two, one — BLAST OFF!
hotspots.sayLocked: The battery slot is empty. We need something to power the rocket!

ja.sayFound: でんちが カチッ！ さん、に、いち — はっしゃ！
ja.sayLocked: でんちの スロット からっぽだ。 ロケットに なにか いるね！

cmn.sayFound: 电池咔嗒一声装好了！三，二，一 — 发射！
cmn.sayLocked: 电池槽是空的。火箭需要动力！

yue.sayFound: 電池咔噠一聲入咗位！三，二，一 — 發射！
yue.sayLocked: 電池位空咗。火箭需要啲嘢嚟發動！

nameT.ja: うさぎさん ロケット！

ja.intro: うさぎさんの ロケット うごかない！ なにか みつけて おつきさまへ しゅっぱつ！
ja.winText: ヒューン！ うさぎさん おつきさまへ ビューン！ ありがとう！

cmn.intro: 兔子火箭开不了！ 找东西，帮它飞月亮！
cmn.winText: 嗖！ 兔子飞到月亮啦 — 谢谢你！

yue.intro: 兔仔嘅火箭開唔到呀！ 搵吓佢需要啲乜，幫佢飛上月球啦！
yue.winText: 嘩！ 兔仔飛咗上月球啦 — 多謝你呀！
